name: Jungle Valley
description: A dense jungle valley with a river running through the center. Asymmetric starting positions — one player gets jungle cover, the other gets road access.
terrain_notes: Player 0 side: heavy jungle. Player 1 side: road network. River in center requires beach crossing.
loading_tip: The jungles of Southeast Asia have been decisive battlegrounds throughout history. Guerrilla fighters have used dense vegetation to defeat technologically superior enemies for centuries.
